args.body: Read the completed selection-contract.json: its precise unresolved dependency is availability of the existing transformer/verifier under the documented frozen service-source paths. Finish existing CATALOGUE-QA-INTEGRATED-DELIVERY from saved evidence under actual valid ownership without rerunning passing tests. Then take CATALOGUE-QA-FROZEN-DEPENDENCIES if no equivalent work exists. Reuse unchanged code and fixtures; verify byte equality and execute from only the documented dependencies. This improves fulfillment readiness without another product or public change. Actual case inclusion still requires its private receipt; do not inspect correspondence or claim integration, delivery or revenue. Preserve all observation and retirement duties.

description: The saved selection contract identifies a concrete fulfillment gap: public-site transformer/verifier paths do not establish availability in private case snapshots. Address that gap using existing code. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; available funds and verified revenue remain zero. Publication restrictions affect specific releases, not this internal preparation.
